assessmentName: AIQ Professional Assessment - Fresh 160 Item Bank
description: A completely fresh professional-level AI assessment with 160 unique items featuring varied response lengths, randomized correct answer positions, and compelling distractors designed to minimize pattern recognition and guessability.

assessmentConfiguration.targetAudience: Professionals actively using AI in strategic contexts

presentationMode.description: Questions adapt to candidate ability level with Item Response Theory (IRT)
presentationMode.sequencing: By dimension, adaptive difficulty within each dimension

dimensionSequencing.description: Candidates complete 20 questions per dimension in sequence with adaptive difficulty

scoringMethod.description: Item Response Theory scoring with adaptive weighting by item difficulty and discrimination
scoringMethod.formula: points = basePoints × (1 + difficulty × 0.4 + discrimination × 0.2) for each correct answer

scoringGuidelines.0-40%: Emerging (0-640 points) - Significant professional development needed

instructions: This AIQ Professional assessment evaluates your advanced AI literacy across 8 key dimensions of strategic human-AI collaboration. You will answer 160 questions total (20 per dimension) in approximately 120 minutes. All questions feature nuanced options requiring genuine professional judgment. Answer all questions to the best of your ability.

assessmentGuidelines.targetLevel: Professional application and strategic AI implementation
assessmentGuidelines.cognitiveEmphasis: 20% Apply (Bloom's level 3), 50% Analyze (Bloom's level 4), 30% Evaluate/Create (Bloom's levels 5-6)
assessmentGuidelines.difficultyProfile: Balanced distribution with realistic options requiring domain expertise
assessmentGuidelines.timeAllocation: Moderate time for application items, extended time for strategic analysis
assessmentGuidelines.designPrinciples: All options are plausible; distractors represent common misconceptions or partially correct approaches; response lengths and correct answer positions randomized to minimize guessability
